title: Cloud Posture dashboard loads without error for an org with a configured provider
preconditions: Org has at least one provider configured and one completed scan
expectedResult: Page loads within a few seconds with no 500/unhandled error, showing overall security score, critical finding count, and a service breakdown section populated with data.

title: Configure page renders credential entry forms for all three supported providers
steps: Switch between the AWS, Azure, and GCP tabs/sections
expectedResult: Each provider's credential form renders its expected fields (AWS: accessKeyId/secretAccessKey/region/accountId; GCP: serviceAccountKey/projectId; Azure: clientId/clientSecret/tenantId) with no console errors or blank tabs.

title: Triggering a scan creates a scan record in an active status
preconditions: A project has a verified provider configuration
steps: Click 'Run Scan' for the configured provider
expectedResult: The API responds success and a new CloudPostureScan record is created with status in the active set (e.g. 'queued' or 'validating'); the UI navigates to or links the new scan's detail page.

title: Provider drill-down page lists services without a server error
preconditions: Provider has at least one completed scan with resources across multiple services
steps: From the dashboard, click into a configured provider
expectedResult: Provider view loads and lists services with resource counts and severity indicators; no 500 error or endless loading spinner.

title: Security checks list renders pass/fail statuses for a completed scan
preconditions: A completed scan with a mix of PASS and FAIL findings exists
steps: Navigate into a service with known findings and open its security checks list
expectedResult: Checks render with clear PASS/FAIL status indicators and are not all shown as a single uniform status; page does not error out.
